# AKI labels (generated by `python -m polysafe.labels`)

T = 24 h. AKI = KDIGO stage >= 1 with onset in (T, min(T + 7 d, ICU discharge)]: >= 0.3 mg/dL rise within 48 h, >= 1.5x baseline within 7 days of it, or acute RRT initiation. Serum creatinine only.

## Incidence (95% Wilson CI)

| Baseline | All sites | Primary: medication-recording sites |
|---|---|---|
| A | 107 / 868 = **12.3%** (10.3-14.7%) | 78 / 671 = **11.6%** (9.4-14.3%) |
| C | 71 / 660 = **10.8%** (8.6-13.4%) | 49 / 497 = **9.9%** (7.5-12.8%) |

## Baseline A

Criterion at onset: rise 75, rise+ratio 26, ratio 6.
Hours from T to onset: median 16.9 (IQR 9.6-41.9).

Post-T follow-up, hours from T to min(T + 7 d, ICU discharge):

| min | 25% | median | 75% | max | >= 48 h | reached 7 d |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 4.2 | 23.9 | 45.3 | 85.9 | 168.0 | 400 (46.1%) | 89 |

Sensitivity (>= 48 h follow-up): all sites 78 / 400 = **19.5%** (15.9-23.7%); primary sites 58 / 314 = **18.5%** (14.6-23.1%).

## Baseline C

Criterion at onset: rise 58, rise+ratio 8, ratio 5.
Hours from T to onset: median 16.4 (IQR 9.2-36.0).

Post-T follow-up, hours from T to min(T + 7 d, ICU discharge):

| min | 25% | median | 75% | max | >= 48 h | reached 7 d |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1.7 | 22.6 | 42.0 | 75.4 | 168.0 | 280 (42.4%) | 51 |

Sensitivity (>= 48 h follow-up): all sites 47 / 280 = **16.8%** (12.9-21.6%); primary sites 33 / 212 = **15.6%** (11.3-21.1%).

## Against DATA_REPORT's provisional 22.6%

The provisional figure (465 / 2,058) counted any 48 h rise anywhere in the record: no T, no exclusions, no baseline, no window. Recounted with the floating-point fix it is 471 / 2,058. Where those stays went (baseline A):

- removed at *Stay < 24 h*: 90
- removed at *Chronic dialysis / ESRD*: 51
- removed at *AKI by T (baseline A)*: 167
- removed at *Acute RRT by T*: 2
- removed at *No baseline A*: 4
- removed at *No observable outcome*: 13
- in the final cohort: 144, of which AKI in the window: 103

## Baseline A vs C

607 stays are labelled under both; they agree on 602 (99.2%).

| | C: no AKI | C: AKI |
|---|---:|---:|
| **A: no AKI** | 538 | 4 |
| **A: AKI** | 1 | 64 |
